properties.description: Account level instead of customer level (CI_DEPOSIT_TRANSACTION)

content.query:
/*
    Standardize the field names to business names
    Add TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP (Converted) field
*/
SELECT 
     HTD.ACID
    ,HTD.TRAN_ID AS TRANSACTION_ID
    ,HTD.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM AS TRANSACTION_SERIAL_NUMBER
    ,HTD.TRAN_DATE AS TRANSACTION_DATE
    ,HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE AS TRANSACTION_CURRENCY_CODE
    ,HTD.TRAN_AMT AS TRANSACTION_AMOUNT
    ,HTD.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP AS TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP
    --,1 TRAN_CNT
    ,HTD.DTH_INIT_SOL_ID AS INITIALIZING_BRANCH_CODE
    ,HTD.PART_TRAN_TYPE AS TRANSACTION_TYPE
    ,HTD.SOL_ID AS BRANCH_CODE
    ,HTD.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCE_CODE
    ,HTD.TRAN_PARTICULAR AS TRANSACTION_PARTICULAR
    ,HTD.TRAN_RMKS AS TRANSACTION_REMARKS
    ,HTD.LCHG_TIME AS CHANGED_TIME
    ,HTD.RCRE_TIME AS CREATED_TIME
    ,HTD.PSTD_DATE AS POSTED_DATE
    ,HTD.BANK_ID AS BANK_ID
---    ,CUST.ORGKEY AS FCBSCIF
    ,DF.FORACID AS ACCOUNT_ID
	,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY HTD.ACID) SK

/*
    Remove the duplicates using ROW_NUMBER() window function
    Convert the transaction amount to PHP (TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP)
*/
FROM (
SELECT
     HTD.ACID
    ,HTD.TRAN_ID
    ,HTD.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM
    ,HTD.TRAN_DATE
    ,HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE
    ,HTD.TRAN_AMT
    ,CASE WHEN HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN HTD.TRAN_AMT 
        ELSE HTD.TRAN_AMT * CC.ConversionRate END AS TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP
    --,1 TRAN_CNT
    ,HTD.DTH_INIT_SOL_ID
    ,HTD.PART_TRAN_TYPE
    ,HTD.SOL_ID
    ,HTD.SOURCE_CODE
    ,HTD.TRAN_PARTICULAR
    ,HTD.TRAN_RMKS
    ,HTD.LCHG_TIME
    ,HTD.RCRE_TIME
    ,HTD.PSTD_DATE
    ,HTD.BANK_ID
    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY HTD.ACID, HTD.TRAN_ID, HTD.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM, HTD.TRAN_DATE  ORDER BY HTD.[FILE_NAME] DESC, HTD.INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN
    FROM [EDS].[DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_CI_2024061] HTD
    LEFT JOIN  (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion where ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV') CC
        ON HTD.BANK_ID = CC.FinancialInstitutionId
        AND HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId
        AND HTD.TRAN_DATE = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
    WHERE BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
    --AND DATEDIFF(M, TRAN_DATE, (SELECT DEPOSITS_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL)) <= 12
    AND TRAN_DATE >= '2023-04-01'
) HTD 
INNER JOIN eds.DEPOSIT_FACT DF
    ON HTD.ACID = DF.GAM_ACID
    AND HTD.BANK_ID = DF.GAM_BANK_ID
    AND HTD.TRAN_DATE = DF.AS_OF_DATE
WHERE RN = 1
